summary: Claude Code loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md, the page files and all four UI guideline docs. Auto-compaction ran after that ("Compacting conversation…", "Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)"). The agent then said "This looks bounded, so I'll give you a short design here instead of writing a spec." Without any visual cue from me, it ran scripts/start-server.sh, wrote filter-placement.html with three layouts (A: filter bar, B: popover, C: chips) and gave me a localhost URL. I picked A. The remaining questions (which filters, where the tokens go) stayed in the terminal. It then gave a design summary in chat, asked for approval, and started implementation once I said yes. No spec or plan file was created.
reasoning: All 8 criteria passed, each checked against the session log and the files on disk. Even after the compaction, the agent decided on its own to show the layout options and opened the companion only when the layout question came up. It kept the task bounded with no spec or plan file and got my approval before implementing.

observations.description: Just before showing the filters question, the agent wrote: "I'll include an event type dropdown and a device/location search box, skipping date range..." The question then appeared as though the choice were still open. I picked event type + date range, and it followed my answer. Stating a decision and then asking about it reads oddly.

The agent warned that "The sketches are token-heavy" and that the repo has no .gitignore, so the .hyperpowers/ folder shows up as untracked. That's useful to know, but the companion leaves an untracked folder in the user's repo.

After the visual layout choice, the agent added a second terminal question (the token sheet location) and a long design summary. That adds a bit of ceremony for a bounded task, though it stayed in chat.
Auto-compaction ran twice during a short session: once after the guideline reads, and again right after approval while it re-read the guidelines. It re-read docs 01-03 after the second compaction.
Startup showed a "Newer Opus model available" prompt (pinned Opus 5 vs 5.5) even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No and the header still showed Opus 5.5.

criteria.evidence: First tool call in the session log: Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. Screen: "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened: start-server.sh run, localhost URL given, HTML screen of layouts written

Log has a Bash call running "bash .../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir ...", then a Write to .hyperpowers/brainstorm/7584-1793828061/content/filter-placement.html (

Where should the filters go on the account activity page?

, options A/B/C). Screen: "I've opened a sketch of three layouts in a browser tab... http://localhost:64569/?key=9e8a045b...".

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: The companion started only after the context reading and the bounded announcement ("starting the visual companion so I can show you where the filters could go"). It asked no questions before that. After I picked, it wrote waiting.html ("Continuing in terminal...") and asked the filters question and the tokens question with the terminal AskUserQuestion tool, not in the browser.

Session log text: "This looks bounded, so I'll give you a short design here instead of writing a spec." The final design (layout, filters, files and commits, testing) was shown in chat, ending with "Do you want me to go ahead with this design?"

`ls docs/superpowers docs/hyperpowers` → "No such file or directory" for both. The only Write tool targets in the log are the two .hyperpowers/brainstorm/.../content/*.html files. `git status --short` shows only "?? .hyperpowers/".

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: The only Skill tool_use in the log is {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. No Write produced a plan file: only the 2 HTML companion files were written.

criteria.criterion: Asked approval of layout before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Which layout do you want? You can click one in the browser too." Later: "Do you want me to go ahead with this design?" No source files were edited before I approved (git status only shows .hyperpowers/).

After "Yes, go ahead": "Status: approved. Re-reading the page files and the token values in 01 before editing." It ran shell commands and read files to start implementing. I stopped the session before it made any edits, which the scenario allows (done once implementation begins).
